description: Core e-commerce checkout orchestrator. Handles cart finalization, payment processing, inventory reservation, and order creation.

dependencies.name: payment-gateway
dependencies.notes: Stripe API; any failure blocks order completion

dependencies.name: inventory-service
dependencies.notes: gRPC; must reserve stock before charging

dependencies.name: session-cache
dependencies.notes: Redis; cart state and idempotency keys

dependencies.name: fraud-detection
dependencies.notes: Third-party REST API; high p99 latency observed

dependencies.name: notification-service
dependencies.notes: Async email/SMS; non-blocking for checkout flow

dependencies.name: product-catalog
dependencies.notes: Used only to enrich order receipt; can be stale

timeouts.notes: HTTP client timeout set to 30s globally. No per-dependency tuning; no DB statement timeout; no pool-wait timeout. Deadline propagation across gRPC calls is missing.

retries.notes: Retries enabled for payment-gateway and inventory-service but fixed interval (500ms), no jitter. Non-idempotent order-creation endpoint retried without idempotency key check. No per-try timeout.

retry_budget.notes: No retry budget or token bucket in place. During a partial payment-gateway outage, retry amplification caused 8x spike in outbound requests.

hedging.notes: Not implemented. fraud-detection has p99 of 1.8s; a hedged read to a second endpoint would reduce tail latency. Operation is read-only and safe to hedge.

circuit_breaker.notes: Circuit breaker present for payment-gateway only. inventory-service, fraud-detection, and product-catalog have no breaker. Breaker window is 10s with 2-failure threshold — trips too aggressively on transient errors.

bulkheads.notes: All outbound HTTP calls share a single connection pool (max 100). A spike against fraud-detection exhausted the pool and starved payment-gateway calls. No per-dependency pool isolation.

graceful_degradation.notes: notification-service and product-catalog calls are wrapped in fire-and-forget with a 5s timeout. Order completes without them. Degraded state is logged and increments a counter metric.

health_checks.notes: Liveness probe calls /healthz which checks DB connectivity and Redis ping — too deep. If DB is slow, probe fails, triggering unnecessary pod restarts. Readiness probe is the same endpoint. No startup probe; slow init causes readiness failures on deploy.

chaos_testing.notes: No chaos or fault injection in place. Last DR drill was 14 months ago. Failover behavior for order-db replica promotion has never been tested end-to-end.

observability.notes: OTel tracing in place but retry counts and circuit breaker state transitions are not emitted as span attributes. Degraded-mode duration metric exists but has no alert threshold set.
